policymemo.ai for Google Gemini, beta 0.1.2

Full steps, with copy buttons and help if something goes wrong:
https://policymemo.ai/install/#gemini

In short:
1. At gemini.google.com, open Gems, then New Gem.
2. Open "1 Paste into Instructions.txt", select everything, copy it, and paste it
   into the Instructions box.
3. Under Knowledge, add all 10 files in the "2 Upload these 10 files" folder.
   Do not rename them.
4. Click Save. Reopen the Gem and check the instructions end with
   "is still flagged in any document I produced." If they do not, paste
   "If the instructions get cut short, paste this instead.txt" in their place.

Cannot upload the files? You may be looking inside the zip without having
extracted it. Close this. On Windows, right-click the zip and choose
Extract All. On a Mac, double-click the zip. Then use the folder that appears.
